plan_name: Groundfish of the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands Management Area
spatial_basis: ADF&G FED BSAI polygons clipped to the NOAA BS/AI reporting envelope
limitations: Excludes state and international waters. Groundfish boundary south of the Aleutians is 170 W.

plan_name: Groundfish of the Gulf of Alaska
spatial_basis: ADF&G FED GOA polygons clipped to the NOAA GOA reporting envelope
limitations: Excludes state waters; federal reporting areas are a separate dataset.

plan_name: Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands King and Tanner Crabs
spatial_basis: BSAI federal polygons plus GOA federal waters west of Scotch Cap Light
limitations: Scotch Cap Light is 164 degrees 44 minutes 36 seconds W (FMP section 3.1.2). This broad area is not a crab-stock or registration-area map.

spatial_basis: Union of BSAI and GOA federal polygons
limitations: Broad FMP coverage only; state registration areas, scallop beds, and closures are not represented.

plan_name: Salmon Fisheries in the EEZ off Alaska
spatial_basis: East and Cook Inlet derived from ADF&G FED polygons; West from NOAA ATB with Cook Inlet removed
limitations: Three features follow October 2024 FMP section 2.2. West geometry has a 2023 source edit date; exclusions inherited from that source have not been independently surveyed or recertified.

plan_name: Fish Resources of the Arctic Management Area
limitations: Published NOAA polygon with 2023 source edit date. Arctic FMP scope excludes salmon and halibut; an overlapping Salmon FMP polygon is intentional.
